services.name: Tandem skydive
services.desc: At Canton Airsports we’re able to start your skydiving lessons and put you on the way to becoming a licensed skydiver. Tandem skydives are the best way to get introduced to freefall before moving onto the training needed to learn to skydive solo, and eventaully get your skydiving license. To start, we’ll have you take a training tandem jump with one our highly experienced instructors. On this training tandem skydive you’ll complete freefall drills, deploy the parachute at the correct altitude, and help fly the parachute, all under the supervision of your instructor.
